Iyer’s Despair & The Society’s Meeting: Iyer is devastated that the sports car he bought for Babita turned out to be stolen, risking both his ₹4 lakh and jail time. The Gokuldham members gather in the clubhouse to brainstorm how to track down the thief, Peter Fernandes.
Step into Jethalal’s world with Gada Electronics! Manage the shop, tackle quirky customers, and experience nonstop TMKOC-style fun.
Are you ready for the challenge?
